chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him), he praises Allah and extols His Prophet, and advises asceticism and piety.

key_terms.الزُّهْد: Asceticism or detachment from worldly desires

ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon in Nahj al-Balagha regarding spiritual virtues?
ai.summary: This excerpt from the 'World and its people' chapter of Nahj al-Balagha encapsulates Imam Ali’s (AS) pedagogical method, linking divine praise and prophetic emulation directly to the practical cultivation of zuhd (asceticism) and taqwa (God-consciousness). In Shia scholarly tradition, this triad serves as the foundational framework for understanding the transient nature of the dunya, urging believers to view material life not as an end, but as a means to spiritual elevation through adherence to the Prophet's example.
